design.scope: Uncalibrated 2D 1T1C; conditional simulation response, not commercial DRAM reliability or radiation cross section

metrics.classification: M>epsilon correct; M<-epsilon criterion_error; closed interval critical

reference.mode: per-condition full neutral BL curve; real twin branch validation
reference.heavyion_scope: signal device only; reference zero source

source.gaussian_truncation: report geometry-based estimate separately; actual integral compared to original total Qdep, never retarget Qdep*F
source.zero_deposition: legal, retain event and paired responses; no replacement

statistics.interval: Wilson 95% two-sided with z=1.959963984540054; envelope over best/worst unresolved assignments using planned N
statistics.zero_event_upper: 1-0.05**(1/N) only if all planned responses determinate and k_error=0
statistics.paired_any_bit: optional; collapse by event first, never double N
statistics.no_multiple_testing_claim: descriptive intervals, not simultaneous coverage or significance claims

prediction.cv: leave-one-physical-condition-out over 8 training (L,particle,angle) groups; all four repeats and both bits stay grouped
prediction.selection_score: arithmetic mean of per-fold RMSE for each bit/target independently
prediction.tie_break: lowest alpha among scores within 1e-12 target units of minimum
prediction.standardization: training fold population mean/std only; zero std replaced with1; final fit uses all training data
prediction.ridge_objective: sum_squared_error + alpha*sum(coef**2); intercept unpenalized; alpha0 via least-squares
prediction.required_training: all 64 training bit responses audited; unresolved outcome blocks prediction freeze
prediction.freeze_before_test: model coefficients/scalers/config, all test input Geant4 events and matched baselines, per-event predictions and SHA256 before any holdout/extrapolation TCAD response
prediction.scope: predict TCAD response given actual Geant4 deposition and known unirradiated baselines; oxide extension excluded from length prediction scores

numerical.matching: event, own control and neutral reference at each variation
numerical.distance: min over epsilon in2.5,5,10 of abs(M-epsilon),abs(M+epsilon)
numerical.selection: all main-matrix responses; sort by(distance,condition_id,replicate,stored_bit); choose first two unique response IDs; reuse if preregistered point selected
numerical.unresolved_near_boundary: mark numerically_uncertain at affected threshold until matching refinement confirms stable classification
numerical.crossing: preserve raw classes and mark numerically_uncertain, never change threshold or seed

oxide_extension.source: controlled assumption ±20% about existing uncalibrated5nm model
oxide_extension.transport_scope: fixed silicon-entry events; Geant4 material stack remains silicon/vacuum

execution.accounting: all new v3 solver wallclock including failed/validation runs; missing solver time uses conservative runner elapsed; inherited runs cost0
execution.submission_stop: before next run if elapsed+conservative_next_estimate>86400; retain fixed planned denominator, no seed replacement
execution.long_run: preserve running solver; inspection before next dispatch, no automatic kill or retry
execution.budget_scope: global shared original v3 ledger; all original, diagnostic, probe and R50-main solver time including failures; no reset or duplicate costs

design.source_freeze_policy: Before each stage dispatch, immutable execution-freeze manifest binds source/dependency hashes and prepared inputs; revised code gets a new manifest, never rewrites prior evidence
